name: Jigoku no Renshuu Mondai
source:
You are an angel-in-training sent into hell to perform a variety of duties, which, like many old text adventures, largely amounts to a treasure hunt to score points. The underworld is not only filled with blood red lakes, needle forests and blazing infernos, but also the spirits of several celebrities and historical figures. Yes, during the course of your adventure, you’ll run into Napoleon Bonaparte, Adolf Hitler, John Wayne, John Lennon, Marilyn Monroe, Cleopatra, Ryoma Sakamoto (a famous samurai), and a figure who appears to be Jesus Christ but is addressed only as “senpai”. You’ll also meet up with Count Dracula, for some reason.

[From [url=http://www.hardcoregaming101.net/jigoku-no-renshuu-mondai/]hardcoregaming101[/url]]
translation:
你是一名正在見習的天使，被派到地獄執行各種任務。如同許多早期文字冒險遊戲，這些任務大多只是收集寶物以賺取分數。冥界不僅有血紅的湖泊、鋼針森林和熊熊烈火，還徘徊著多位名人與歷史人物的靈魂。

沒錯，在冒險途中，你會遇見拿破崙．波拿巴、阿道夫．希特勒、約翰．韋恩、約翰．列儂、瑪麗蓮．夢露、克麗奧佩脫拉、坂本龍馬，以及一位疑似耶穌基督、卻始終只被稱為「前輩」的人物。不知為何，你甚至還會碰上德古拉伯爵。

［引自[url=http://www.hardcoregaming101.net/jigoku-no-renshuu-mondai/]hardcoregaming101[/url]］
